independence.sanitization_scope: Packet permits authoritative contract, test inventory, Git version metadata and public assertion outcomes only
independence.limitations: No product execution inferred; serial authoring chronology is not proved by final snapshot or reviewed here.

dependency_closure.basis: All four test files use only standard-library unittest and public shipping imports. No shared fixtures/helpers, mocks, setup/cleanup, async ordering or timing. Packet explicitly declares no extra configuration. Test-tree inventory matches.

validity_standards.basis: Concrete public API calls are evaluated inside direct assertEqual assertions or the narrow assertRaises context. Independent expected values come from README and the public package. Currency compares public exported value to specified USD. Tests use established unittest convention, no private seams or implementation-dependent assertions.

counterfactuals.broken: 500 or another unequal result fails; exceptions fail/error
counterfactuals.causal_chain: Call result is directly compared to sourced 0

counterfactuals.broken: 0 or another unequal result fails; exceptions fail/error
counterfactuals.causal_chain: Call result is directly compared to sourced 500

counterfactuals.compliant: The sole call shipping_fee(-1) raises ValueError
counterfactuals.broken: Returning normally fails assertRaises; TypeError, RuntimeError, or another unrelated exception errors rather than passing
counterfactuals.causal_chain: Only required public call is inside exception context; no unrelated action can supply success. ValueError subclasses are appropriately accepted; no exact-type or message restriction is sourced.

counterfactuals.broken: Changed currency fails equality; missing export fails import
counterfactuals.causal_chain: Public exported currency is compared with independently specified USD

mechanism_check_method: Static reasoning only; simple synchronous predicates do not require synthetic clock/event execution.
numeric_provenance: 10000, 9999, 500, 0 and -1 derive from authoritative README/package. No deadlines, waits or performance assertions. Type validation and unspecified exception text are not asserted.
